report.clinical_summary: Patient with HIV on Dovato (dolutegravir + lamivudine) for 5 months reports fatigue, loss of appetite, vivid dreams, mild anxiety-related insomnia, and occasional nausea. Viral load dropped from 45,000 to 120 copies/mL, CD4 stable at 480 cells/μL. Symptoms started a few weeks after treatment began and haven't improved significantly. Patient takes medication once daily in the morning, adheres to regimen, and discusses symptoms with doctor who explained vivid dreams are a common dolutegravir side effect with options if symptoms continue. Patient trusts doctor's expertise and focuses on self-care practices.

I can still function fairly well during the day
